{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows low positivity (0.00) and model overestimates prices.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude when recent history shows strong upward momentum but model fails to follow.",
    "Increase forecast if sentiment history includes 0.67 or higher and model underestimates price spikes.",
    "Apply mean reversion correction if model consistently overpredicts after recent high prices (e.g., >70.00).",
    "Correct for lag: if true outcome is significantly higher than model forecast, adjust next period’s forecast upward by 10–15% of the gap.",
    "Avoid overshoot after spikes: if model forecasts >75.00 after a spike, reduce by 5–10% to prevent overcorrection.",
    "Use sentiment as a proxy for volatility: if sentiment >0.50, increase forecast variance by 5% to reflect higher uncertainty."
  ]
}
